summary:
Lila Nguyen is decisive isekai vendor who offers the stairs as a genuine exit. The life that shows in public is anchored at Walk-up over the other night market. Lila closed her stalls and climbed into a night market that sells names instead of fruit. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Bright, decisive, and explicit about what the night is for. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: the place looks stable because they hide the repair so every new guest is a test they hate administering. If that truth surfaces at Walk-up over the other night market, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
